tasks.task_name: Define CodeReviewConfig struct and code review domain types
tasks.goal: CodeReviewConfig is parseable from YAML with all fields (MaxRounds, MaxCostUSD, MaxWallClockMinutes, FixerTimeoutSeconds, CommitMode, StalenessThreshold, MaxRetries, ReviewerTimeoutSeconds), defaults are applied, validation rejects invalid values, and all code-review domain types (FixOutput, FixAction, FixStatus, TestResults, GrillCodeMode, CodeReviewVerdict) are defined with JSON tags.

outputs.name: config_struct
outputs.constraints: all numeric fields >= 0, CommitMode in {branch_per_round, direct_commit}

outputs.name: domain_types
outputs.constraints: FixOutput, FixAction, FixStatus, TestResults, GrillCodeMode, CodeReviewVerdict types defined

acceptance: DefaultCodeReviewConfig() returns MaxRounds=3, MaxCostUSD=50.0, MaxWallClockMinutes=120, FixerTimeoutSeconds=600, CommitMode=branch_per_round, StalenessThreshold=2, MaxRetries=2, ReviewerTimeoutSeconds=300
Parsing YAML with max_rounds: 5 produces MaxRounds=5
ValidateConfig returns error for CommitMode=invalid containing 'must be one of'
ValidateConfig returns error for MaxRounds=-1 containing 'must be >= 0'
FixStatus constants FixStatusFixed, FixStatusDeferred, FixStatusFailed equal 'fixed', 'deferred', 'failed'
GrillCodeMode has values CodeOnly, SpecOnly, FullContext
CodeReviewVerdict has values VerdictPass, VerdictPassWithObservations, VerdictRevise
go test ./internal/codereview/ -run TestConfig passes
go test ./internal/codereview/ -run TestTypes passes

depends_on.reason: First task, new package with no dependencies on other new code

constraints: New package internal/codereview separate from specworkflow
Use yaml struct tags consistent with existing config patterns

tasks.task_name: Implement code review state machine with transitions and guards
tasks.goal: A StateMachine instance for code review enforces the transition table (CR_INIT -> CR_HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE -> CR_REVIEWING -> CR_FIXING -> CR_HUMAN_GATE_FIXES -> CR_COMPLETE/CR_ESCALATED) with MaxRoundsGuard blocking CR_REVIEWING when round > max_rounds, CostGuard blocking when over budget, and WallClockGuard blocking when over time.

outputs.name: state_machine
outputs.constraints: all CR_ states defined, transition table enforced, guards implemented

acceptance: States CR_INIT, CR_HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE, CR_REVIEWING, CR_FIXING, CR_HUMAN_GATE_FIXES, CR_COMPLETE, CR_ESCALATED are defined as string constants
Transition from CR_HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE to CR_REVIEWING succeeds
Transition from CR_REVIEWING to CR_INIT returns error containing 'invalid transition'
MaxRoundsGuard blocks transition to CR_REVIEWING when round=4 and max_rounds=3
MaxRoundsGuard allows transition to CR_REVIEWING when round=3 and max_rounds=3
MaxRoundsGuard blocks transition to CR_REVIEWING when round=1 and max_rounds=0
CostGuard blocks when cumulative cost > max_cost_usd with reason containing 'cost budget exceeded'
WallClockGuard blocks when elapsed minutes > max_wall_clock_minutes with reason containing 'wall clock budget exceeded'
go test ./internal/codereview/ -run TestStateMachine passes
constraints: Replicate the StateMachine pattern from specworkflow but with code review specific states and transitions

tasks.task_name: Implement severity-based convergence routing and staleness detection
tasks.goal: EvaluateConvergence returns VerdictPass (route to CR_COMPLETE) for zero findings, VerdictPassWithObservations (route to CR_HUMAN_GATE_FIXES) for minor/observation-only findings, VerdictRevise (route to CR_FIXING) for critical/major findings, and DetectStaleness returns true after StalenessThreshold consecutive rounds without decrease in open CRITICAL+MAJOR count.
acceptance: EvaluateConvergence with 0 findings returns VerdictPass and CR_COMPLETE
EvaluateConvergence with 3 MINOR and 2 OBSERVATION returns VerdictPassWithObservations and CR_HUMAN_GATE_FIXES
EvaluateConvergence with 1 CRITICAL and 0 MAJOR returns VerdictRevise and CR_FIXING
EvaluateConvergence with 0 CRITICAL and 2 MAJOR returns VerdictRevise and CR_FIXING
DetectStaleness with history [3, 3] and threshold 2 returns true
DetectStaleness with history [3, 4] and threshold 2 returns true (got worse counts as no improvement)
DetectStaleness with history [3, 2] and threshold 2 returns false (improvement)
DetectStaleness with history [3, 4, 2] and threshold 2 returns false (counter resets on decrease)
go test ./internal/codereview/ -run TestConvergence passes
constraints: No LLM judge invocation -- pure severity-based routing

tasks.task_name: Parameterize DispatchReviewers with lensGroups and MergeReviewerOutputs with DedupKeyFunc and PromoteSeverity
tasks.goal: DispatchReviewers accepts a lensGroups []string parameter instead of using hardcoded reviewerLensGroups, MergeReviewerOutputs accepts DedupKeyFunc and PromoteSeverity parameters replacing the hardcoded isDuplicate logic, existing spec workflow callers pass the original 4 lens groups with PromoteSeverity=true and the 3-tuple key function, and all existing spec workflow tests pass unchanged.
acceptance: DispatchReviewers signature includes lensGroups []string parameter
Existing spec workflow callers pass []string{clarity, consistency, security, correctness} explicitly
MergeReviewerOutputs signature includes DedupKeyFunc func(*Finding) string and PromoteSeverity bool parameters
Spec workflow callers pass PromoteSeverity=true with the existing 3-tuple key function (affected_section, lens, constitution_principle)
Code review dedup key function produces key from (file_path, line_range, lens, severity) where file_path and line_range are extracted from AffectedSection
Two findings at same file:line, same lens, same severity are merged (single output)
Two findings at same file:line, same lens, different severity are NOT merged (two outputs)
Spec workflow merge with PromoteSeverity=true still promotes higher severity on duplicate (MAJOR + CRITICAL = CRITICAL kept)
go test ./internal/specworkflow/ passes with zero failures (full existing test suite)
go test ./internal/codereview/ -run TestDedupKey passes
constraints: Must not break any existing spec workflow behavior
Existing callers must be updated in the same change

tasks.task_name: Implement grill-code reviewer prompt builder and fix agent prompt builder
tasks.goal: BuildReviewerPrompt produces a prompt string containing the lens name, grill-code skill content, code_path, spec content (if provided), and grill-code mode; BuildFixAgentPrompt produces a prompt string containing the findings file path, spec content (if provided), all non-behavior constraints, FixOutput JSON schema, and submodule exclusion instructions.

outputs.name: fix_prompt
outputs.constraints: contains findings path, non-behaviors, FixOutput schema

acceptance: BuildReviewerPrompt('security', '/repo', 'spec content', FullContext) contains '--lens security'
BuildReviewerPrompt('correctness', '/repo', '', CodeOnly) contains 'code-only' and does not contain spec content placeholder
BuildFixAgentPrompt('/workspace/findings.json', 'spec text', []) contains the findings file path

BuildFixAgentPrompt includes all 11 non-behavior constraints from the spec (force-push, branch deletion, .gitignore, outside scope, merge, git clean, own repo, grill-spec, dependencies, symlinks, submodules)
BuildFixAgentPrompt includes FixOutput JSON schema description
BuildFixAgentPrompt includes instruction not to traverse or modify submodule directories
go test ./internal/codereview/ -run TestPrompt passes
constraints: Prompt content must match the integration boundary contract from the spec

tasks.task_name: Implement FixOutput JSON parsing and routing logic
tasks.goal: ParseFixOutput parses FixOutput JSON, rejects invalid/malformed JSON with a descriptive error, and RouteAfterFix returns CR_REVIEWING when all CRITICAL+MAJOR findings have status fixed, CR_HUMAN_GATE_FIXES when any are deferred or failed, and CR_HUMAN_GATE_FIXES with parse error warning when JSON is invalid.

inputs.name: raw_json
inputs.constraints: JSON bytes from fix agent stdout

acceptance: ParseFixOutput with valid JSON containing round=1, fixes_applied with 2 entries returns FixOutput with correct fields
ParseFixOutput with empty JSON {} returns error containing 'missing required fields'
ParseFixOutput with invalid JSON returns error containing 'parse error'
ParseFixOutput with status value 'invalid' returns error containing 'invalid fix status'
RouteAfterFix where all findings have status=fixed returns CR_REVIEWING
RouteAfterFix where one finding has status=deferred returns CR_HUMAN_GATE_FIXES
RouteAfterFix where one finding has status=failed returns CR_HUMAN_GATE_FIXES
RouteAfterFix with parse error returns CR_HUMAN_GATE_FIXES with warning 'fix output parse error'
ParseFixOutput with test_results=null returns FixOutput with nil TestResults (valid)
go test ./internal/codereview/ -run TestFixOutput passes
constraints: Strict validation -- unknown status values are parse errors, not silently accepted

tasks.task_name: Implement atomic workflow state persistence and recovery for code review
tasks.goal: SaveState writes workflow-state.json atomically (temp file + rename) containing all workflow fields (state, round, cumulative_cost_usd, cumulative_wall_clock_seconds, feature_name, code_path, spec_path, grill_code_mode, git_branch, git_sha, warnings), LoadState reads it back correctly, and RecoverFromCrash detects partial state (agent output files for CR_REVIEWING, uncommitted git changes for CR_FIXING) and returns the correct recovery action.
acceptance: SaveState writes to a temp file then renames to workflow-state.json
LoadState reads workflow-state.json and returns WorkflowState with all fields including cumulative_cost_usd and round
RecoverFromCrash in CR_REVIEWING state with 8 of 12 valid output files returns RecoveryAction with 4 agents to re-dispatch
RecoverFromCrash in CR_REVIEWING state with a corrupt output file (invalid JSON) deletes the corrupt file and includes that agent in the re-dispatch list
RecoverFromCrash in CR_REVIEWING state ignores output files from previous rounds
RecoverFromCrash in CR_FIXING state with uncommitted git changes returns route to CR_HUMAN_GATE_FIXES with partial fix warning and list of uncommitted files
RecoverFromCrash in CR_FIXING state with no uncommitted changes and no FixOutput file returns re-dispatch fix agent action
RecoverFromCrash in gate state returns resume-at-gate action
Circuit breaker values (cost, wall clock, round) survive save/load cycle
go test ./internal/codereview/ -run TestPersistence passes
constraints: Atomic writes to prevent corruption on crash
Output file naming must match review-{provider}-{lens}-round-{N}.json convention

tasks.task_name: Implement code review orchestrator initialization and scope gate
tasks.goal: CodeReviewOrchestrator.Start validates inputs (code_path exists, is git repo, no path traversal, feature_name is kebab-case, spec_path exists if provided), creates workspace directory, snapshots git state, detects grill-code mode, persists initial state, and transitions to CR_HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE; HandleScopeGate transitions to CR_REVIEWING on confirm and CR_ESCALATED on cancel.

inputs.name: start_request
inputs.constraints: code_path required, feature_name required and kebab-case

acceptance: Start with valid code_path pointing to git repo creates workspace/code-reviews/{feature_name}/ directory
Start captures git branch name and HEAD SHA in workflow state
Start with spec_path and task_list_path sets mode to FullContext
Start with spec_path only sets mode to SpecOnly
Start with neither spec_path nor task_list_path sets mode to CodeOnly
Start with nonexistent code_path returns error containing 'does not exist'
Start with non-git directory returns error containing 'not a git repository'
Start with feature_name containing spaces returns error containing 'kebab-case'
Start with feature_name 'My-Feature' (uppercase) returns error containing 'kebab-case'
Start with code_path containing '..' returns error containing path traversal indicator
Start with nonexistent spec_path returns error containing 'spec file not found'
HandleScopeGate with confirm transitions to CR_REVIEWING
HandleScopeGate with cancel transitions to CR_ESCALATED with reason containing 'operator cancelled'
go test ./internal/codereview/ -run TestOrchestrator passes
constraints: Must validate all inputs before creating workspace directory
Git operations use standard exec.Command calls

tasks.task_name: Implement code review orchestrator review dispatch and merge phase
tasks.goal: The review phase dispatches 12 agents (6 lens groups x 2 providers) when Codex is available or 6 Claude-only agents when Codex is unavailable, collects outputs, merges findings using the code review dedup key, writes code-findings-round-N.json, evaluates convergence, checks circuit breakers and staleness, and transitions to the correct next state.
acceptance: With both runners available, 12 agents are dispatched (6 Claude + 6 Codex across correctness, security, testing, error-handling, observability, overcomplexity)
With CodexRunner unavailable, 6 Claude-only agents are dispatched and reduced_coverage warning is stored
Merged findings file code-findings-round-1.json is written to workspace
Deduplication uses code review key (file_path, line_range, lens, severity)
Zero findings routes to CR_COMPLETE
Minor-only findings routes to CR_HUMAN_GATE_FIXES with VerdictPassWithObservations
Critical findings routes to CR_FIXING
More than half agents failing routes to CR_ESCALATED
Cost guard blocks dispatch when over budget
Staleness detection triggers after configured threshold of non-improvement
MaxRoundsGuard blocks re-review transition when round exceeds max_rounds
go test ./internal/codereview/ -run TestReviewPhase passes
constraints: Must reuse DispatchReviewers from specworkflow with 6 code review lens groups
Agent failures handled with retry up to max_retries

tasks.task_name: Implement code review orchestrator fix agent dispatch and post-fix validation
tasks.goal: The fix phase creates a branch (branch_per_round mode) or stays on current branch (direct_commit mode), dispatches the fix agent with --allowedTools restriction and WorkspaceDir set to code_path, parses FixOutput, validates all modified files are within code_path via git diff --name-only, handles timeout (SIGTERM/SIGKILL) and OOM, and routes to the correct next state.
acceptance: In branch_per_round mode, creates branch cr-fix-round-1 from HEAD
In branch_per_round mode with pre-existing cr-fix-round-1, deletes old branch before creating new one
In direct_commit mode, no new branch is created
Fix agent command includes --allowedTools 'Read,Write,Bash' and does NOT include --dangerously-skip-permissions
Fix agent WorkspaceDir is set to code_path
Post-fix validation runs git diff --name-only and escalates if any file is outside code_path
Post-fix validation checks that no files in submodule paths were modified
All findings fixed routes to CR_REVIEWING
Any deferred or failed findings routes to CR_HUMAN_GATE_FIXES
Fix agent timeout fires SIGTERM, waits 5 seconds, then SIGKILL; uncommitted files listed in warning
Fix agent killed by signal routes to CR_HUMAN_GATE_FIXES with 'killed by signal' warning
Fix agent parse error routes to CR_HUMAN_GATE_FIXES with 'fix output parse error' warning
Fix agent exit code != 0 (non-timeout) routes to CR_HUMAN_GATE_FIXES with error details, no retry
go test ./internal/codereview/ -run TestFixPhase passes
constraints: Fix agent is NOT retried on failure (side effects are not idempotent)
Must enforce --allowedTools restriction, never --dangerously-skip-permissions

tasks.task_name: Implement human gate logic for scope gate display and fixes gate with structured data
tasks.goal: GetScopeGateData returns scope details (spec path, code path, task list path, grill-code mode, git branch, HEAD SHA); GetFixesGateData returns findings summary, fix details, deferred items, git diff stat, structured test results, and reduced_coverage warning if applicable; HandleFixesGate transitions correctly for re-review (increment round), accept, and escalate actions; human comments are persisted to human-comments.json.

inputs.name: gate_action
inputs.constraints: re-review, accept, or escalate for fixes gate

acceptance: GetScopeGateData returns spec_path, code_path, task_list_path, grill_code_mode, git_branch, git_sha
GetFixesGateData returns findings summary with open/closed counts by severity
GetFixesGateData returns fix details with finding IDs and descriptions
GetFixesGateData returns structured test results with total, passed, failed, and failure names
GetFixesGateData returns reduced_coverage warning when Codex was unavailable
HandleFixesGate with re-review transitions to CR_REVIEWING and increments round counter
HandleFixesGate with accept transitions to CR_COMPLETE
HandleFixesGate with escalate transitions to CR_ESCALATED
Human comment is appended to human-comments.json in workspace directory
go test ./internal/codereview/ -run TestHumanGate passes
constraints: Gate data must include all fields specified in US-2 and US-5

tasks.task_name: Implement WebSocket event emission for code review workflow
tasks.goal: The code review orchestrator emits workflow_status events on state transitions, agent_dispatch events when agents start, agent_complete events when agents finish, and gate_request events at human gates, all via the shared EventEmitter interface with feature_name in every event.
acceptance: State transition from CR_HUMAN_GATE_SCOPE to CR_REVIEWING emits workflow_status event with state=CR_REVIEWING
Agent dispatch emits agent_dispatch event with agent name, lens group, and provider
Agent completion emits agent_complete event with agent name, success/failure, duration, and cost
Human gate activation emits gate_request event with gate type and available actions
All events include feature_name field
Events are fire-and-forget (no error if no WebSocket clients connected)
go test ./internal/codereview/ -run TestEvents passes
constraints: Reuse existing EventEmitter interface and ChannelEmitter from specworkflow

tasks.task_name: Implement HTTP API handlers for code review endpoints
tasks.goal: Six API endpoints are registered: POST /api/codereview/start (validates input, creates orchestrator, returns 200/400/409), POST /api/codereview/{feature_name}/gate (validates action per gate state, returns 200/400/404/409), GET /api/codereview/{feature_name}/status (returns state, round, cost, findings, active agents), POST /api/codereview/{feature_name}/cancel (terminates agents, returns 200/404), POST /api/codereview/{feature_name}/resume (resumes from persisted state, returns 200/404), POST /api/codereview/{feature_name}/reset (deletes workspace for terminal states, returns 200/404/409).

inputs.name: http_request
inputs.constraints: valid JSON body for POST endpoints

acceptance: POST /api/codereview/start with valid body returns 200 {status: started}
POST /api/codereview/start with missing code_path returns 400
POST /api/codereview/start with duplicate feature_name returns 409
POST /api/codereview/{feature}/gate with valid action returns 200 {status: transitioned, new_state: ...}
POST /api/codereview/{feature}/gate with invalid action returns 400 containing 'invalid gate action'
POST /api/codereview/{feature}/gate when not in gate state returns 409
POST /api/codereview/{feature}/gate with unknown feature returns 404
GET /api/codereview/{feature}/status returns state, round, cost_usd, wall_clock_minutes, findings_summary, active_agents
GET /api/codereview/unknown/status returns 404
POST /api/codereview/{feature}/cancel for running workflow returns 200
POST /api/codereview/{feature}/cancel for unknown feature returns 404
POST /api/codereview/{feature}/resume for persisted workflow returns 200
POST /api/codereview/{feature}/reset for completed workflow returns 200 and deletes workspace
POST /api/codereview/{feature}/reset for running workflow returns 409
go test ./internal/api/ -run TestCodeReview passes
constraints: Routes must not conflict with existing /api/workflow/* routes
WorkflowManager must use a separate sync.RWMutex for code review orchestrator map

tasks.task_name: Add JSONL audit logging for code review workflow actions
tasks.goal: All code review workflow starts, gate submissions, cancellations, and resets are logged to the JSONL audit log via WorkflowLogger with timestamp, action, feature_name, and relevant metadata (gate action, escalation reason, etc.).

inputs.constraints: key-value pairs for the log entry

outputs.name: log_entries
outputs.constraints: each line has timestamp, action, feature_name, metadata

acceptance: Workflow start logs entry with action=codereview_start and feature_name
Gate submission logs entry with action=codereview_gate and gate_action field
Cancellation logs entry with action=codereview_cancel and reason field
Reset logs entry with action=codereview_reset and feature_name
All log entries include ISO 8601 timestamp

tasks.task_name: Implement workflow cancellation with agent termination
tasks.goal: POST /api/codereview/{feature_name}/cancel sets a cancellation flag, terminates all running agent subprocesses, and transitions the workflow to CR_ESCALATED with reason 'operator cancelled'; POST to a nonexistent feature returns 404.
acceptance: Cancel for running workflow terminates agent subprocesses
Cancel transitions workflow to CR_ESCALATED with reason containing 'operator cancelled'
Cancel for nonexistent feature returns 404
Cancel persists the escalated state to workflow-state.json
go test ./internal/codereview/ -run TestCancel passes
constraints: Agent termination must use SIGTERM then SIGKILL pattern

tasks.task_name: Implement crash recovery with output file validation and circuit breaker resumption
tasks.goal: On server restart, LoadPersistedWorkflows discovers all workflow-state.json files in workspace/code-reviews/*, RecoverWorkflow resumes workflows from persisted state (gate states resume at gate, CR_REVIEWING checks output files and re-dispatches missing agents, CR_FIXING checks git status for uncommitted changes), and circuit breakers resume from persisted values.
acceptance: LoadPersistedWorkflows finds all workflow-state.json files under workspace/code-reviews/
Workflow in CR_HUMAN_GATE_FIXES resumes at that gate state via POST /api/codereview/{feature}/resume
Workflow in CR_REVIEWING with 8 of 12 valid output files re-dispatches only 4 missing agents
Workflow in CR_REVIEWING with corrupt output file (invalid JSON) deletes the corrupt file and re-dispatches that agent
Workflow in CR_REVIEWING ignores output files from previous rounds (only current round loaded)
Workflow in CR_FIXING with uncommitted git changes routes to CR_HUMAN_GATE_FIXES with partial fix warning and uncommitted file list
Workflow in CR_FIXING with no uncommitted changes and no FixOutput re-dispatches fix agent
Circuit breaker values (cost, wall clock, round) resume from persisted state, not reset to 0
go test ./internal/codereview/ -run TestCrashRecovery passes
constraints: Output file naming convention: review-{provider}-{lens}-round-{N}.json
Only valid JSON output files are loaded; corrupt files are deleted

tasks.task_name: Implement workspace cleanup for completed or escalated workflows
tasks.goal: POST /api/codereview/{feature_name}/reset deletes workspace/code-reviews/{feature_name}/ directory and removes the orchestrator instance for workflows in CR_COMPLETE or CR_ESCALATED state, returns 409 for running workflows, and returns 404 for unknown features.
acceptance: Reset for completed workflow deletes workspace/code-reviews/{feature_name}/ directory
Reset for completed workflow removes orchestrator from WorkflowManager
Reset for running workflow returns 409 with 'cannot reset running workflow'
Reset for unknown feature returns 404
Reset does NOT delete cr-fix-round-* branches in the target repository
go test ./internal/codereview/ -run TestReset passes
constraints: Only deletes workspace artifacts, never touches target repository branches

tasks.goal: Integration tests cover: full INIT -> SCOPE -> REVIEW -> FIX -> RE-REVIEW -> COMPLETE loop with mock runners, Claude-only fallback, majority agent failure escalation, all gate action combinations, all circuit breaker triggers, staleness escalation, concurrent workflows for different features, and regression tests verifying spec workflow DispatchReviewers and MergeReviewerOutputs still work unchanged.

TestCircuitBreakers: cost, wall-clock, and max-rounds breakers all fire at configured thresholds
TestStalenessEscalation: 2-round staleness with non-improving findings triggers human gate warning
TestConcurrentWorkflows: two workflows for different features operate independently
TestSpecWorkflowRegression: spec workflow DispatchReviewers with 4 groups and MergeReviewerOutputs with PromoteSeverity=true produce identical results to pre-change behavior
